cityNote: Kensington is an unincorporated community in Contra Costa County in the Berkeley Hills. It borders Berkeley, but the address is Kensington.
summary: a 4 bedroom, 3 bath, ±2,187 sq ft single-story, level-in home on a 7,565 sq ft lot at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in Kensington, in the Berkeley Hills. Built in 1962, it has a new roof, modern electrical, an all-new primary suite, a custom kitchen with new appliances, gardens with Wildcat Canyon views, and a two-car attached garage. Ye Olde School Trail, a footpath toward Kensington Elementary, runs right next door.

Layout and interior: Single-story and level-in: no stairs to enter and none inside.
All 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms on the main level; generous closets in every bedroom.
Custom kitchen with new appliances, stone counters, island, breakfast bar, pantry and skylights; gas range, built-in oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, disposal.
Large living room with a wood-burning brick honeycomb fireplace.
Separate dining room and family room.
Four sets of doors open directly to the gardens.
Systems and condition: Clean inspection reports; full disclosure package available from the listing agent.
Outdoors: Gardens are the standout feature: dry-stacked stone walls, pergolas, flagstone patios and low-maintenance plantings.
Wildcat Canyon views from the front yard.
Fully fenced yard, including the front; landscaped front and back.

location.intro: Kensington is a small, unincorporated residential community in the Berkeley Hills, bordering Berkeley to the south and El Cerrito to the north. 22 Kensington Court sits off Cowper Avenue near Arlington Avenue.
points: Ye Olde School Trail runs next to the property: a wooded footpath toward Kensington Elementary.
Colusa Circle, Kensington's small village center, is nearby.
Solano Avenue (Albany/Berkeley) restaurants and shops are a short drive.
Tilden Regional Park and Wildcat Canyon Regional Park are minutes away.

What elementary school serves the home?
Kensington is in West Contra Costa Unified. Kensington Elementary is a walk away via Ye Olde School Trail. Buyers should confirm the assignment directly with the district.
